digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center backend transport adapter
propositions: JiraDataCenterTransport must implement TicketTransport, SupportsLinks, SupportsComments, and SupportsAbsenceProbe roles using pycontribs/jira as a lazily-imported optional dependency, never shipping the jira package with the base rebar install.

DC authentication uses Personal Access Token (PAT) from JIRA_PAT env var passed as bearer token auth; JIRA_URL and JIRA_PROJECT come from typed config, and ConfigError is raised loudly on malformed config rather than degrading to env-only.
TLS must be enforced: non-https base_url is rejected with ConfigError unless allow_insecure=true; certificate verification is never disabled in the client; ca_bundle config key supports internal CAs.

Every TicketTransport method returns raw payload dicts matching the shared _jira_shape_contract assertions, not wrapped jira.Issue objects, ensuring the DC and Cloud implementations produce identical downstream shapes.

HTTP errors are not retried (exactly one attempt); ConnectionError, Timeout, and TimeoutError are retried with 2s/5s backoff matching acli_rest; unknown assignees raise BackendAssigneeNotFoundError on apply.

The DC transport is registered into _backend_registry via a self-registration import in adapters/__init__.py, making select_backend('jira-datacenter') resolve after 'import rebar_reconciler.adapters'.
